text.content: Sprint 1 — Problem scoping and design.

text.content: Choose a business problem, or a fallback option, and scope it. Define measurable success criteria. Decide which concepts the build needs (RAG, agent, agentic workflow, human-in-the-loop) and which implementation path fits. Produce the architecture and the build plan, and take them through peer review.

text.content: Sprint 2 — Building the core system.

rich_text.plain_text: Sprint 2 — Building the core system.

text.content: Set up the environment and connect every data source, real or clearly labelled synthetic. Build a thin working slice end to end, iterate until it is reliable, and integrate the AI components the architecture called for. Run the mid-build checkpoint of 5–10 diagnostic cases and adjust the plan against what it shows.

Publish the project artefacts to GitHub.
